verdict.rationale: The only pricing evidence is a single tier mention ('Solo Plan $10/month') with no breakdown of how adding a new data source, connector, or asset affects cost, and no documented usage-based cost calculator or per-source pricing metric that would let a platform lead estimate costs before connecting a new source. Missing for 10: published usage/pricing metrics tied to sources or assets, a cost calculator, and any documentation of how connector integrations (dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt) affect billing.
